lab_overrides: Host binaries/units, account entries and public QEMU root are overlaid in RAM on the earlier immutable lab host.
Gateway root is the production image, without a synthetic provider or TLS override.
Session guest uses production token receiver/network setup and compiled OpenCode; an unprivileged Python console fixture replaces only the interactive entrypoint.
The adapter probe invokes the actual production conversation launcher with run/standalone arguments.
Host gateway stderr goes to the volatile lab journal. Production unit output remains null.
The outer lab host has no NIC. This cannot demonstrate successful Internet/Tor/provider access.

failed_attempts.observed_failure: Guest startup completed, but the console probe timed out. The fixture did not wait for its READY marker.
failed_attempts.resolution: Wait for the guest console READY marker and retain sanitized diagnostics. Also added an explicit virtio-port-open handshake before token delivery; the first failure did not establish that token delivery was lost.

checks.native_clippy: passed --all-targets --features lab-emulation -- -D warnings; Linux code compiled and exercised in Debian VM

artifact_retention: Verified obsolete synthetic data.raw disks from run-01/run-02 and earlier host-gateway run-01 through run-07 were removed to recover Mac disk space. Their summaries, logs and recorded disk hashes remain; final passing disks are retained.
limits: The compiled adapter test proves local-token authentication and acceptance of at least the emitted request payload; Tor-disabled provider_unavailable is the expected response. Successful streaming, tool calling, titles and compaction remain unverified through this integration.

The token is deliberately available to the session UID and its tools, in guest tmpfs and OpenCode environment. It is not the provider key. The adapter probe found no token in its output or regular vault files.
Runtime-file scans check the known test keys and tokens after closure. The outer raw-disk scan checks fixed synthetic markers, not a universal absence of sensitive data.
No packet-capture or complete syscall trace was added by this suite; the independent gateway network laboratory supplies prior firewall/Tor evidence.
VM exit is not physical erasure of all Mac RAM copies. The laboratory is not the final live image.
